## v0.1.12

- Enrich IMDb/TMDb title requests with TMDb posters, descriptions, release dates, genres, ratings and runtimes using an admin-configured API token.
- Show OIDC `display_name` or `name` for users while preserving stable subject IDs for authorization; show requester names in the admin request list and email notifications.
- Add per-episode download controls and keep season downloads as separate downloads for every episode.
- Standardize compact green download buttons across cards, episodes, seasons and details.
- Make the sidebar version label link to GitHub's latest release and mark update availability.
- Bundle the TMDb logo and keep its credits visible without relying on a remote logo URL.
- Refine poster card sizing and request-list layout.
